messages:
maya: Heads-up — our sample-app embedding pipeline is breaking on prod tests. Looks like the REST /v1/embeddings/batch endpoint supports an optional `return_raw_metadata` flag but the JS SDK doesn't surface it.

jonah: repro? stack/logs? :eyes:

maya: minimal repro: from curl it works:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"inputs": ["foo", "bar"], "return_raw_metadata": true}'
```
returns 200 with metadata array.

maya: with the JS SDK (v1.8.2) using `client.embeddings.create()` the option is ignored — metadata is omitted. sample app then crashes when it tries to attach source ids.

samir: interesting — could be param name mapping (camelCase vs snake_case) or the SDK explicitly whitelists allowed keys. can you paste the snippet?

maya: snippet:
```js
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'open-embed-1',
  inputs: ['foo', 'bar'],
  returnRawMetadata: true
});
```

jonah: ahh there it is — `returnRawMetadata` vs `return_raw_metadata`. The REST accepts snake_case only. We used a helper to normalize params in the SDK but it only normalizes known keys. New flag wasn't added to the mapper.

cleo: do we want to make the SDK auto-pass-through unknown keys? that risks sending bad params to runtime. :thinking_face:

samir: safer fix: add explicit mapping and a unit test. Also add an integration test in sample-app to assert metadata present. I'll PR.

maya: another wrinkle — when REST receives `return_raw_metadata` and the metadata service is slow, REST returns 202 + Location while SDK currently treats non-200 as retryable and immediately retries, which duplicates downstream work. we saw doubled indexing jobs.

jonah: build-bot: show last two deploy events for embeddings-service?

build-bot: "deploy embedding-service v3.2.4 succeeded at 2145678000"

maya: logs from indexing pipeline: `202 ACCEPTED -> job queued id=ix_123` then SDK retried and caused `202 -> job queued id=ix_124`. We should treat 202 as success (queued) not retryable for this endpoint.

cleo: agreed. We need two changes: 1) SDK param alias for return_raw_metadata, 2) SDK should treat 202 as terminal success for embeddings.batch. open an issue with both items and mark P1?

samir: I'll open the issue. quick plan in comments: implement mapping in js-sdk, add e2e that posts with the flag and asserts single queue job, update retry policy for client.embeddings.create to consider 202 non-retry.

jonah: also call out the sample-app template default timeout — it was 10s and caused an extra retry on longer metadata fetch. we should bump to 30s in template.

maya: adding reproduction notes to the thread: 1) curl vs SDK difference, 2) logs showing duplicate job ids, 3) sdk version and sample-app commit hash.

cleo: tagging the release owner @jonah for patch cutoff today.

jonah: got it. I'll shepherd the PRs: one for param mapping + test, one for retry behavior, and a small docs note in the sample-app README.

samir: PRs created: js-sdk#412 and js-sdk#413. linking here when ready.

maya: thanks team. leaving this open until PRs merged and sample-app updated. :thumbsup:
